title: 2.5 This one, but that one
unit_outcome: Say where and how people go, what people have and what things are, compare people and things, and understand classroom commands in Spanish.
goal: Contrast near and far: Esta bolsa es roja, pero esa bolsa es azul. Esta es roja, pero esa es azul.
grammar_function: este/esta, ese/esa (agreeing) with and without the noun; pero.
prerequisite: Spanish A1 Unit 2 and A1+ Unit 1 and A1+ 2.1-2.4.
